runs.rejection_summary: Lower-priority candidates were withheld because they leaned too strongly toward outbreak/survival or psychological horror, were comparatively slow/withholding, scored below the 82-point threshold, or lost out to stronger candidates at the configured daily series cap. No existing-library duplicates were found among the accepted titles.

The effective feedback reinforced suspense and mystery as positive qualities even when a title's overall rating is only moderate, while a DNF for boredom strengthened the existing penalty on slow or withholding material. The run therefore favored investigation-heavy science, biology/ecology, experimental technology and reality-rule discovery; slower/ambiguous psychological entries and more survival/action-oriented candidates were withheld. Superseded feedback was not double-counted, and previously discovered/library titles encountered during research were deduplicated.

Current active feedback strongly reinforced suspense, alien/unknown mystery and explicit More Like This preference while retracted chains contributed zero taste weight. The run therefore prioritized active scientific investigation, genetics/biology, experiments with escalating consequences and discoverable reality/time systems; action-first, generic creature, psychological-horror and slow-withholding candidates were penalized. Existing library and prior discovery state were checked before acceptance.

Current active evidence kept premise interest positive for investigative biology while separately softening creature/chase-heavy presentation, and independently reinforced suspense plus alien/unknown mystery. The run therefore favored genetic experiments, impossible systems with discoverable rules, reality anomalies, scientific UFO investigation and escalating mystery; more generic creature, action-first and horror-first candidates were withheld. Superseded and retracted feedback contributed no active taste weight.

Current active feedback reinforced explicit interest in investigative science, unusual phenomena, mystery and premise-driven discovery while keeping creature content separate from chase-heavy presentation. The run therefore favored laboratory experiments, mind/reality systems, parallel-world mechanics and science-led anomaly investigation; weaker action-first, generic horror and insufficiently investigative candidates were withheld. Retracted chains contributed zero taste weight.

Current active feedback favored premise-driven experimental science, biology, mystery and suspense while keeping execution complaints title-specific and creature interest separate from chase-heavy presentation. All six researched candidates cleared the threshold and were new public identities; retracted chains contributed zero taste weight. Unsupported feedback schemas: 0.

Current active evidence continued to favor premise-driven science, unusual phenomena, mystery, rule discovery and reality anomalies. One researched candidate was already present in the public watch catalog and was deduplicated. Unsupported feedback schemas: 0.
